questions.prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone, while others think students should pay at least part of the cost. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many people think that working from home is better for employees than working in an office. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people argue that governments should spend more money on public transport than on building new roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school rather than at secondary school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think that exams are the best way to assess students, while others believe continuous assessment is more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people prefer to live in large cities, while others prefer smaller towns or rural areas. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that employers should allow staff to work flexible hours, while others think fixed schedules are more productive. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people think that advertising encourages consumers to buy things they do not need, while others believe it provides useful information. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
An increasing number of people are choosing to work remotely. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
Many cities are encouraging residents to use electric vehicles. Do the advantages of this policy outweigh the disadvantages?
More students are taking online courses instead of attending traditional classes. Do the advantages of online learning outweigh the disadvantages?
Some countries are investing heavily in space exploration. Do the advantages of this spending outweigh the disadvantages?
Traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem in many cities. What problems does it cause, and what measures could be taken to reduce it?
Many young people find it difficult to buy their first home. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
Plastic waste is damaging the environment in many parts of the world. What problems does this cause, and what actions should governments and individuals take?
An increasing number of people report feeling stressed at work. What problems does this cause, and how can employers help?
More people are moving away from their hometowns to find work. Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?
Many people spend less time cooking at home than in the past. Why is this the case? Is it a positive or negative development?
Some young people change jobs frequently. Why do they do this? Is this a positive or negative development?
More consumers are buying second-hand goods instead of new products. Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?
